# Plinth

> Open-core infrastructure for solo builders: Forms, Catch, Schema.

## Products
- Forms: https://plinthrun.com/forms — static site form backend
- Catch: https://plinthrun.com/catch — webhook request bin
- Schema: https://plinthrun.com/schema — LLM JSON repair + JSON Schema validation

## API
- Base: https://api.plinthrun.com
- Docs: https://plinthrun.com/docs
- MCP: https://api.plinthrun.com/mcp
- Health: https://api.plinthrun.com/health

## Packages
- @plinth/schema
- @plinth/forms
- @plinth/catch

## Pricing
- Free quotas on every product
- Pro $19/mo · Team $49/mo (Polar merchant of record)
